entries.title: Remove GitHub security advisory commitment
entries.rationale: Removing upstream security-reporting commitments is not an application feature and would weaken or alter Zion's security-governance boundary. Do not intake the deletion; retain Zion's independently reviewed security policy.
security_reasons: changes vulnerability disclosure and security-response commitments
policy deletion has governance and reporting impact
verification: Full-SHA SECURITY.md diff and security-governance impact reviewed; no source implementation made.
